name: Good Trade Gold PRO EA
changelog: Good Trade Gold PRO V7.78 - CME 3-Tier Matrix & Adaptive Buffer Suite: Comprehensive institutional upgrade addressing the 4305 Put Wall proximity incident. Expands base proximity detection to 600 pts ($6.00) around major Put/Call walls. Adds Intermediate Half-Century strikes (.50) including 4350 Intermediate Call (905 OI) and 4250 Intermediate Put (2,150 OI) with 300 pt buffer. Introduces Expiration Guard / DTE tracking with dynamic buffer expansion (+150 pts) during Gamma Pinning (DTE <= 3 days). Integrates two-way symmetric CME Reversal Sniper Flip (blocking Sells at Put support and arming Buy snipers; blocking Buys at Call resistance and arming Sell snipers). Enhanced HUD Card 2 revTag and Amber/Cyan visual drawings on chart.
